name: Toekomstmuziek
description: Toekomstmuziek is a cultural hub on Danzigerbocht in the Houthavens area, where art, live music, street food, craft beer and wine come together. The small two-storey building has pale brick walls that curve round the corner, square yellow-framed windows on the upper floor and a glazed entrance under a painted sign board.
funFact: Toekomstmuziek describes its philosophy as making the music sector more sustainable for artists while making live music accessible to everybody.
